rows.definition: Crowley’s 1909 tabulation of magical correspondences across dozens of systems, all arranged on the Qabalistic Tree of Life. Each column is one "language"; each row one station of the Tree.
The central Qabalistic diagram: ten Sephiroth (spheres) joined by 22 paths, mapping all existence from the divine Crown (Kether) down to the material world (Malkuth).
The ten spheres or emanations, numbered 1–10 (Kether…Malkuth), each a mode of being and a planet/force.
The 22 lines joining the Sephiroth, each carried by a Hebrew letter and a Tarot trump — Keys 11–32 in the table.
The rows of the table: 0 = the Veils of the Negative; 1–10 = Sephiroth; 11–32 = paths. "32 bis" and "31 bis" are the elemental attributions (Earth, Spirit) Crowley added to Tau and Shin.
The four levels of reality, matched to the four letters of יהוה: Atziluth (archetypal/spirit), Briah (creative), Yetzirah (formative/astral), Assiah (material).

King (Atziluth), Queen (Briah), Emperor/Prince (Yetzirah), Empress/Princess (Assiah). Every row has a colour in each world. The classic Tree paints Sephiroth in the Queen scale and paths in the King scale.
Complementary pairs (red/green, blue/orange, yellow/violet) that optically vibrate. A symbol painted on its complement "flashes," which the tradition holds charges a talisman or aids scrying.
The A∴A∴/Rosicrucian grades of attainment, each seated on a Sephira and written X°=Y□ — from Neophyte 0°=0□ (Malkuth) up to Ipsissimus 10°=1□ (Kether).
The state of awareness a station confers (Col IV) and its spiritual attainment or "vision" (Col XLV) — e.g. Tiphareth’s Beatific Vision, Malkuth’s Vision of the Holy Guardian Angel.
Hebrew numerology: each letter is also a number, so every word carries a sum. Equal sums are read as hidden kinship — יהוה = 26 = twice 13 = אחד (Unity) = אהבה (Love).
The Arabic equivalent of gematria; the first 22 letters share the Hebrew values, with six extra letters running 500–1000.
A condensed magical glyph. Rose-Cross sigils trace a name across the rose of the 22 letters; Kamea/Wafq sigils trace it across a planet’s magic square.
A planetary magic square, every row, column and diagonal summing alike — the ground for planetary sigils and talismans. Called kamea (Hebrew) or wafq (Arabic).
The 3×3 (Saturn) square whose corner numbers 2·4·6·8 spell ب د و ح — worn as a protective charm for safety, travel and childbirth.
A set of seven talismanic signs from al-Būnī’s Shams al-Maʿārif, aligned to the seven planets/days and held to unlock the Greatest Name of God.
Day (sunrise→sunset) and night (sunset→sunrise) each split into twelve unequal "hours," ruled in the Chaldean order ♄ ♃ ♂ ☉ ♀ ☿ ☽ starting from the planet of the weekday.
The 36 ten-degree divisions of the zodiac (three per sign), each ruled by a planet and matched to a minor Tarot card (the 2s–10s).
22 trumps = the paths; 16 court cards = an element within a suit’s element; 40 minors = the ten Sephiroth across the four suits (the four worlds).
The "shells" — the averse or demonic counterparts of the Sephiroth (Col VIII).
"The Small World" — the fully-coloured Tree of Life, Sephiroth in Queen scale and paths in King scale.
Argenteum Astrum ("Silver Star") — the magical order Crowley co-founded; its grades structure the table.
The Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn, source of most of these attributions.
The Holy Guardian Angel; "Knowledge & Conversation of the HGA" is the central attainment, seated at Tiphareth.
"Light" — the Rosicrucian formula of the grade signs.
The Rosicrucian/alchemical formula (Igne Natura Renovatur Integra — "by fire nature is wholly renewed").
Latin "or," as in "Liber 777 vel Prolegomena…".
"again / a second time" — the extra elemental rows 31 bis (Spirit) and 32 bis (Earth).
